Os dois começam com 5 créditos. A Corpor: Both players start with 5 credits. The Corp goes first and doesn't draw a card on the first turn.
Turno da Corporação: compra obrigatória,: Corp turn: mandatory draw, 3 clicks, discard. Runner turn: 4 clicks, discard.
Vence quem chegar a 7 pontos de agenda (: The first to reach 7 agenda points wins (applied automatically). The Runner also loses if they take more damage than cards in their grip; the Corp loses if it must draw from an empty R&D.
Memória do Runner (MU): mostra usada / m: Runner memory (MU): shows used / max. Max starts at 4 and increases with hardware or the identity; used goes up when installing programs. If it exceeds the max, the Runner must trash programs.
Todos começam com 5 cartas na mão. Taman: Everyone starts with 5 cards in hand. Max hand size: 5, minus the Runner's core damage. Drawing adds 1 card; installing and playing an operation/event remove 1; the Corp's mandatory draw is added at the start of its turn.
